notes.title: participating in the Tokyo Game Show!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981520/5071743007096f4941180d06090c1f1db1920eb1.png[/img]

Event: Tokyo Game Show 2024, 26-29 September 
Place: Makuhari Messe
Exhibit location: 4-Hall C57, 'Gyeonggi Content Agency' booth

Based on the feedback received from the limited distribution demo version in Korea, which was centered on the narrative, <Prologue Episode>, which was developed completely new around detective elements, will be unveiled for the first time at the Tokyo Game Show 2024.

In addition, the new system 'Live Conversation', which was influenced by PSP's hidden masterpiece, Diamond and The Sound of a Gun shot, will be introduced for the first time.

<Prologue Episode> launches an investigation to solve the 'social murder case' and not only finds the truth and culprit of the case. You can investigate the criminal you find yourself and refute the criminal's lies.
Please note that only the Japanese version is available for play at this Tokyo game show.

We have prepared a variety of gifts for those who visited in person, so please come and join us!

After this, the English version of the Prologue Episode will be released for free as a Steam demo for Steam users.
If you couldn't make it to the exhibition, please wait for the release of the Steam demo!

see you soon!
